event_name: Document 12 Date 23 November 2018 Time 17:42 2018 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 22 - 25 November The driver and team representative are required to report to the Stewards at 19:15 in relation to the incident below.
reason: Alleged breach of Appendix L Chapter IV Article 4 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code, crossing the white line separating the pit entry and the track in P1 at 14:35 hrs. The Stewards Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Felipe Giaffone Mahir Al Badri
title: Doc 12 2018 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix Summons Car 44 Pit Entry Incident In P1
